column1: I|/aɪ/|pron.|我|基础|basic-expression|I think::我认为;I hope::我希望|I keep a notebook beside my bed.::我在床边放着一本笔记本。|My sister and I walked home together.::我和姐姐一起步行回家。
be|/biː/|v.; aux.|是；存在；成为；用于构成时态和语态|基础|basic-expression|be ready::准备好;be able to::能够|Please be ready to leave at eight.::请在八点做好出发准备。|There may be a simpler way to explain this.::也许有更简单的解释方法。
not|/nɑːt/|adv.|不；没有|基础|basic-expression|not yet::还没有;not at all::一点也不|I have not finished the book yet.::我还没有读完这本书。|The task was not as difficult as expected.::这项任务没有预想的那么难。
no|/noʊ/|det.; exclam.|没有；不；用于否定回答|基础|basic-expression|no problem::没问题;no longer::不再|There is no need to hurry.::没有必要着急。|No, I have not seen your notebook.::没有，我没见过你的笔记本。
yes|/jes/|exclam.; n.|是的；肯定的回答|基础|basic-expression|say yes::答应;a yes or no answer::肯定或否定的回答|Yes, I would like another cup of tea.::好的，我还想要一杯茶。|She said yes when we asked her to join.::我们邀请她参加时，她答应了。
can|/kən; kæn/|aux.|能；会；可以|基础|basic-modals|can do::能够做;as soon as one can::尽快|Can you help me move this table?::你能帮我搬这张桌子吗？|We can see the mountains from this window.::从这扇窗户能看到群山。
may|/meɪ/|aux.|可能；可以；但愿|基础|basic-modals|may be::可能是;may I::我可以……吗|The weather may change during the afternoon.::下午的天气可能会变化。|May I ask you a question?::我可以问你一个问题吗？
must|/mʌst/|aux.|必须；一定；很可能|基础|basic-modals|must do::必须做;must be::一定是|We must check the figures before publishing them.::发布数字之前，我们必须核查。|You must be tired after such a long journey.::这么长的旅途过后，你一定累了。
should|/ʃʊd/|aux.|应该；预计会|基础|basic-modals|should do::应该做;should be::应该是；预计会|You should read the instructions before starting.::开始之前，你应该阅读说明。|The parcel should arrive before the weekend.::包裹预计会在周末前送达。
will|/wɪl/|aux.; n.|将；愿意；意志|基础|basic-modals|will be::将会是;free will::自由意志|We will meet outside the library tomorrow.::我们明天将在图书馆外见面。|Her strong will helped her continue.::她坚强的意志帮助她坚持下去。
would|/wʊd/|aux.|会；愿意；用于委婉或假设表达|基础|basic-modals|would like::想要;would rather::宁愿|Would you like to sit by the window?::你想坐在窗边吗？|I would walk if the weather were better.::如果天气更好，我就会步行。
who|/huː/|pron.|谁；引出指人的从句|基础|basic-questions|who else::还有谁;the person who::……的人|Who left this book on the table?::谁把这本书留在桌上了？|She thanked the person who helped her.::她向帮助她的那个人表示了感谢。
what|/wʌt/|pron.; det.|什么；所……的事物|基础|basic-questions|what kind of::哪一种;what else::还有什么|What kind of books do you enjoy?::你喜欢哪一种书？|Tell me what happened after the meeting.::告诉我会议后发生了什么。
which|/wɪtʃ/|pron.; det.|哪一个；引出指物的从句|基础|basic-questions|which one::哪一个;which way::哪条路|Which one of these maps is newer?::这些地图中哪一张更新？|Which way should we go from here?::从这里我们该走哪条路？
where|/wer/|adv.; conj.|在哪里；在……的地方|基础|basic-questions|where to go::去哪里;where possible::在可能的情况下|Where did you put the spare key?::你把备用钥匙放在哪里了？|This is where we first met.::这就是我们第一次见面的地方。
why|/waɪ/|adv.|为什么；……的原因|基础|basic-questions|why not::为什么不;the reason why::……的原因|Why did the plan change so suddenly?::计划为什么突然改变了？|She explained why the road was closed.::她解释了道路封闭的原因。
how|/haʊ/|adv.|怎样；如何；多么|基础|basic-questions|how often::多久一次;how long::多长时间|How often do you visit the library?::你多久去一次图书馆？|Show me how you organized these notes.::给我看看你是如何整理这些笔记的。
here|/hɪr/|adv.|这里；在这里|基础|basic-context|over here::在这边;from here::从这里|Please leave your wet shoes here.::请把湿鞋留在这里。|The station is a short walk from here.::从这里走一小会儿就能到车站。
there|/ðer/|adv.; pron.|那里；用于表示存在|基础|basic-context|over there::在那边;there is::有|Your bag is on the chair over there.::你的包在那边的椅子上。|There is a quiet place behind the building.::楼后有个安静的地方。
other|/ˈʌðər/|adj.; pron.|其他的；另外的人或物|基础|basic-context|each other::彼此;on the other hand::另一方面|The two teams helped each other.::这两个团队互相帮助。|Do you have any other questions?::你还有其他问题吗？

another|/əˈnʌðər/|det.; pron.|另一个；又一个|基础|basic-context|another day::改天；另一天;one after another::一个接一个|Could I have another glass of water?::我可以再要一杯水吗？|The visitors entered one after another.::访客们一个接一个地走了进来。
such|/sʌtʃ/|det.; pron.|这样的；如此的|基础|basic-context|such as::例如;as such::就其本身而言|Small changes such as these can save time.::像这样的微小改变可以节省时间。|I had never seen such a quiet street.::我从未见过这么安静的街道。
very|/ˈveri/|adv.; adj.|很；非常；恰好的|基础|basic-degree|very much::非常;the very same::正是同一个|Thank you very much for your help.::非常感谢你的帮助。|This is the very same book I borrowed.::这正是我借过的那本书。

also|/ˈɔːlsoʊ/|adv.|也；此外|基础|basic-degree|also known as::也称为;not only ... but also ...::不但……而且|She teaches music and also writes stories.::她教音乐，也写故事。|This plant is also known as a desert rose.::这种植物也称为沙漠玫瑰。
only|/ˈoʊnli/|adv.; adj.|只；仅仅；唯一的|基础|basic-degree|only one::只有一个;not only::不仅|Only one person knew the answer.::只有一个人知道答案。|This is the only road to the village.::这是通往村庄的唯一道路。
too|/tuː/|adv.|也；太；过于|基础|basic-degree|too much::太多;too late::太晚|The box is too heavy for me.::这个箱子对我来说太重了。|She wants to join the walk too.::她也想参加这次步行活动。

again|/əˈɡen/|adv.|再次；又；再说|基础|basic-frequency|once again::再一次;again and again::一再地|Please read the last sentence again.::请再读一遍最后一句。|We checked the figures again before sending them.::发送这些数字之前，我们又核对了一遍。
always|/ˈɔːlweɪz/|adv.|总是；一直|基础|basic-frequency|as always::和往常一样;always remember::始终记得|She always carries a small notebook.::她总是随身带着一本小笔记本。|As always, the library was quiet.::和往常一样，图书馆很安静。
never|/ˈnevər/|adv.|从不；绝不|基础|basic-frequency|never again::再也不;never mind::没关系|I have never visited this museum before.::我以前从未参观过这座博物馆。|Never leave the door open at night.::夜里绝不要让门开着。

sometimes|/ˈsʌmtaɪmz/|adv.|有时；偶尔|基础|basic-frequency|sometimes difficult::有时困难;only sometimes::只是有时|We sometimes meet for lunch after class.::我们有时在课后见面吃午餐。|A simple explanation is sometimes the most useful.::简单的解释有时最有用。
